components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-contrast Electric Lime primary action button for commits and creation.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 18px; background: var(--as-accent-primary, #84cc16); color: var(--as-accent-text, #1a2e05); border: 1px solid var(--as-accent-primary, #84cc16); border-radius: var(--as-radius-sm, 4px); font-family: var(--as-font-body, sans-serif); font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 100ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--as-accent-hover, #65a30d); border-color: var(--as-accent-hover, #65a30d); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--as-accent-primary, #84cc16); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Elevated obsidian control for non-destructive secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 18px; background: var(--as-bg-elevated, #18181f); color: var(--as-text-primary, #f4f4f5); border: 1px solid var(--as-border-strong, #33333f); border-radius: var(--as-radius-sm, 4px); font-family: var(--as-font-body, sans-serif); font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--as-bg-overlay, #202029); border-color: var(--as-text-secondary, #a1a1aa); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--as-accent-primary, #84cc16); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input Field
components.description: Recessed obsidian form input with 44px height and crisp lime focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-label { font-family: var(--as-font-body, sans-serif); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--as-text-secondary, #a1a1aa); letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-input { height: 44px; padding: 10px 14px; background: var(--as-bg-base, #0a0a0c); border: 1px solid var(--as-border-subtle, #22222a); border-radius: var(--as-radius-sm, 4px); color: var(--as-text-primary, #f4f4f5); caret-color: var(--as-accent-primary, #84cc16); font-family: var(--as-font-body, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--as-text-muted, #71717a); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--as-border-focus, #84cc16); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--as-border-focus, #84cc16); }

components.name: Category Filter Chip
components.description: Pill-shaped operational filter toggle with tabular count telemetry.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(132, 204, 22, 0.12); border: 1px solid var(--as-accent-primary, #84cc16); color: var(--as-accent-primary, #84cc16); font-family: var(--as-font-mono, monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 100ms ease, border-color 100ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover { background: rgba(132, 204, 22, 0.18); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--as-accent-primary, #84cc16); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
MoneyDumb implements the idleAustin design language for high-stakes personal financial operations: a four-tier solid obsidian surface hierarchy (#0a0a0c through #202029), crisp 1px structural hairlines, tabular monospace telemetry, and a single surgical Electric Lime (#84cc16) signal color. Rather than disguising financial stress behind pastel fintech illustrations or decorative glassmorphism, the interface behaves like a calm, precision instrument panel built for payday bill execution and debt amortization.

Density is deliberate and task-governed. Working screens (This Month, Debts, Expenses, Income, Accounts) keep related numbers tightly grouped with generous structural intervals between regions so the eye can scan balances, due dates, and post-obligation safe cash in a single pass. Every interactive surface rejects ornamental blur, glowing ambient orbs, emojis, and exclamation points in favor of crisp vector iconography and deadpan, unambiguous microcopy.
keyCharacteristics: Four-step monotonic Pure Obsidian luminance ladder with zero backdrop-filter: blur glassmorphism and zero decorative orbs.
Restrained Electric Lime accent reserved for primary actions, active route/tab selection, focus rings, and positive safe-cash emphasis.
Tri-voice typographic system pairing Outfit structural headings, Geist UI copy, and Fira Code tabular financial numerals.
Geometric 2.0px-stroke Lucide vector icons with accessible names and hover-safe tooltips; zero emojis or icon fonts.
Snappy 100ms–150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) state transitions with reduced-motion fidelity.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Electric Lime owns primary action, active selection, and keyboard focus; never scatter it as decorative borders or background washes across inactive cards.

rules.name: The Semantic Pairing Rule
rules.body: Status colors (success, warning, error, info) never communicate state by hue alone—always pair them with explicit text (Cleared, Overdue, −$420.00) or a distinct geometric icon.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every currency amount, percentage, due day, and countdown renders in Fira Code with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums and right-alignment inside table columns so decimal points align vertically.

rules.name: The Readable Floor Rule
rules.body: Operational metadata and badges stay at or above 11px (0.6875rem), reserving 10px (0.625rem) strictly for .kbd keycap badges; mobile text inputs always render at 16px (1rem) to prevent forced iOS viewport zoom.

rules.name: The Pure Obsidian Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never use backdrop-filter: blur, translucent frosted cards, or decorative glowing background orbs; hierarchy comes from solid surface steps and 1px borders.

rules.name: The Earned Shadow Rule
rules.body: Inline cards and stat tiles sit flat on the canvas with 1px borders; directional shadows appear only on popovers, drawers, toasts, and modals that genuinely overlap content beneath them.

dos: Do use --as-* CSS custom properties for every surface, border, text, accent, and status color across stylesheets and TSX components.
Do format all dollar amounts, APRs, percentages, and due dates in Fira Code (--as-font-mono) with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums and right-align numeric table columns.
Do provide explicit loading skeletons, actionable error banners with retry controls, and helpful empty states on every data-fetching route so slow or failed requests never flash false empty states.
Do attach role="dialog", aria-modal="true", aria-labelledby, Escape key dismissal, and <label htmlFor> bindings to every modal and slide-over drawer.
Do theme native browser surfaces (color-scheme: dark, ::selection, caret-color, custom scrollbars, :focus-visible) to match the Pure Obsidian + Electric Lime palette.
donts: Don't render emojis, Unicode dingbats (✓, ✕, ⚠️), Material Symbols, or exclamation points (!) anywhere in UI components, tooltips, alerts, or empty states.
Don't apply backdrop-filter: blur, .ambient-orb glows, gradient text, eyebrows/kickers above headings, nested cards-in-cards, or > 1px colored side borders.
Don't load or reference legacy typefaces (Inter, Space Grotesk, JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono).
Don't suppress focus outlines (outline: none) without an immediate high-contrast :focus-visible replacement, or mutate hover styles via inline onMouseOver/onMouseOut handlers.
Don't set mobile input font sizes below 16px (1rem) or interactive mobile tap targets below 44x44px at <= 640px.
